title: CityCode: Building Agent-Operable 3D Cities from Sparse Aerial Observations
abstract: Urban spatial intelligence calls for 3D cities that agents can measure, interpret, and modify across successive tasks. Maintaining such cities as persistent, code-based states requires lightweight acquisition and support for consistent state updates without repeated dense reconstruction. We therefore formulate a new setting for grounded urban world construction: generating large-scale, instance-level parameterized 3D cities from one low-altitude aerial RGB image per region and known camera parameters, while recovering metrically scaled buildings and explicit road geometry and connectivity. We introduce CityCode, an agent-operable representation that unifies metric geometry, urban topology, visual semantics, and 3D assets through persistent entity identities, with dependency-aware versioned execution for validated updates and historical restoration. We further develop Air2Code to construct this representation by combining visual structure extraction with adapted metric depth estimation. To address occlusion and incomplete coverage, recovered structure and observed appearance guide generative completion and subsequent structure-aware 3D generation for buildings and backgrounds. Experiments on CitySample-Aerial and UrbanScene3D demonstrate substantially more accurate metric structure recovery and superior visual fidelity to the target cities compared with the evaluated baselines. Across 50 task chains of 50 steps each, CityCode supports continued querying, editing, planning, and historical restoration over evolving city states. Together, CityCode and Air2Code turn sparse aerial observations into persistent, agent-operable urban worlds for long-horizon urban spatial intelligence.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.18342v1 的 13 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：not-found。
analysis.ideaZh: CityCode 将城市拆为有 persistent IDs 的 metric structures、observations 和 assets，以 versioned state、依赖更新与验证支持 agent 连续编辑；Air2Code 从稀疏 aerial images 构建该状态并做有约束的生成补全。作者报告几何、视觉与 2,500 步 task checks；值得深读其可审计设计状态，但当前 v1 未附所引用的 supplementary/code。
analysis.motivationZh: 稀疏 aerial observations 构建的城市若仅有渲染资产，难以保持 metric structure、道路关系和长期编辑历史的一致性。
analysis.methodZh: CityCode 将城市拆为有 persistent IDs 的 metric structures、observations 和 assets，以 versioned state、依赖更新与验证支持 agent 连续编辑；Air2Code 从稀疏 aerial images 构建该状态并做有约束的生成补全。作者报告几何、视觉与 2,500 步 task checks；值得深读其可审计设计状态，但当前 v1 未附所引用的 supplementary/code。
methodFlow: aerial RGB 与 known cameras 恢复 metric depth、instances 与 road topology
proxy、source/roof evidence 引导 appearance completion
structure-aware TRELLIS.2 与 height-guided background 生成资产
metric registration 后绑定 persistent entity IDs
revision-bound agent queries/edits 经依赖检查发布新 snapshot
analysis.experimentsZh: CS-Aerial synthetic map split，UrbanScene3D 三个 real-world-derived mesh renders；已知 cameras 与 ground elevation priors；547 building fidelity instances。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告 CS-Aerial DSM RMSE 14.37m，对比 Sat2Density++ 33.99m；50 条 50 步 task chains 的 2,500 步均通过其定义的 task checks。（Table 2; Sec. 4.4, p. 8） 对照范围：对比 GaussianCity、CityDreamer4D、Sat3DGen、UrbanWorld2.0、MajutsuCity 等；baseline 输入/功能边界不同，执行能力诊断不等于公平通用 agent leaderboard。 消融与诊断：Table 4 交叉 depth adaptation/calibration，比较 completion、height correction 与 structure losses；多数组件有收益，TRELLIS.2 仍有最高 DINO similarity。
analysis.insightZh: 把 scene generation 与持续、可恢复、验证过的城市操作状态耦合；不是仅一次让 LLM 输出 Blender code。
analysis.evidenceZh: CityCode 把 structural footprint、生成资产与 observed evidence 分开保存，identity 跨 revisions 保留。（Sec. 3.1, Fig. 2, p. 4）；stale edits 拒绝、按依赖更新几何/道路，restore 发布为新 revision。（Sec. 3.3, p. 6）；作者报告 CS-Aerial DSM RMSE 14.37m，对比 Sat2Density++ 33.99m；50 条 50 步 task chains 的 2,500 步均通过其定义的 task checks。（Table 2; Sec. 4.4, p. 8）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接研究可编辑 3D artifact 的 agent planning/execution/verification，persistent state 对设计闭环有基础价值。
analysis.caveatZh: v1 首页明确仅 main paper/references，所引用 appendix、code 和 video 未包含，无法复核全部 task protocol。；依赖已知 camera、地面高度、外部 image models 与先验；generated unseen facades 不能当作忠实重建证据。；2,500 步为受限 operation checks，不证明真实城市模拟或任意 agent task 成功。
